description.ncbi_summary: Predicted to enable calcium ion binding activity and glycosaminoglycan binding activity. Predicted to be involved in animal organ morphogenesis and tissue development. Predicted to act upstream of or within extracellular matrix organization; peptide cross-linking via chondroitin 4-sulfate glycosaminoglycan; and positive regulation of cell-substrate adhesion. Part of cell surface. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Involved in both the retinal photoreceptor ribbon synapse formation and physiological functions of visual perception. Plays a key role in the synaptic organization of photoreceptors by mediating transsynaptic interaction between alpha-dystroglycan and GPR179 on the postsynaptic membrane. Necessary for proper bipolar dendritic tip apposition to the photoreceptor ribbon synapse. Promotes matrix assembly and cell adhesiveness.
